units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 3:1:2">Y. Hor. III, beg. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>הוא וכל דו׳ דידיה</he> Himself and His entire staff (of angels); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 2:1:4">Y. Snh. II, 20ᵃ</cite> top <he>דר׳</he>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:27">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>היה מניח דר׳ שלו</he> he (Moses) left his escort.—Y’lamd. to Num. XII, 1, quot. in Ar. <he>דרוגין</he>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:20">Num. R. s. 4</cite> <he>שיהיו עושין דר׳ לפניו</he> that they should form a hierarchy of officers before him. Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ bot. <he>חמא דורגין דידיה וכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:10:1">Koh. R. to IX, 10</cite> <he>דרגין</he> (corr. acc.) he saw his (R. Ḥiya’s) suite in the future world, and his eyes became dim.
